last_action: Finished and shipped a diffusion-limited aggregation (DLA) simulation (/dla.html, v4.5): particles launch from the rim and random-walk blindly until they touch the cluster and stick, so a dense branching fractal grows by intercepting more walkers (Witten & Sander, 1981). Point / wall / manual-paint seeds, a stickiness slider (deterministic via a seeded mulberry32 PRNG), six palettes, three colour modes, and a seed-based share link that reproduces the exact same structure. Verified end-to-end headlessly: the shipped dla.js grows a ~3,876-grain cluster reaching ~157px and is byte-identical across runs for a given seed (and differs for a different seed). Wired into nav, sitemap, API manifest, self-check, selftest, and the Work list; bumped SITE_VERSION to 4.5.
note: heartbeat_epoch/generated_epoch are filled in at deploy/heartbeat time.
